subject: mathematics
concept: Proving triangle congruence using SSS, SAS, ASA, and AAS criteria
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student builds two triangles from matching physical side/angle pieces to test each congruence criterion
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a pair of triangles with marked congruent parts to the correct congruence criterion
exercise.abstract: Student determines which congruence criterion (if any) proves two given triangles congruent

misconception_flags: accepts a non-valid criterion like AAA or SSA as proof of congruence

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
